stories.headline: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower

stories.headline: Treasury yields fall as investors crowd into bonds for safety amid election stock sell-off
stories.body: Treasury yields fell on Tuesday night, as investors sought shelter from a sell-off in equity futures sparked by big victories from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections.

stories.headline: Bank advocate Andy Barr clinches Kentucky Senate seat
stories.body: Andy Barr, the chairman of the subcommittee on financial services in the House, won his bid to replace retiring Sen. Mitch McConnell, R-Ky.
